intake.output: A direction brief with real user answers, uncertainty and the next decision; no invented approval.

evidence.output: An appraisal with real search/source evidence, closest-work comparisons, contrary findings and method feasibility; use workflow_contract.md appraisal JSON.

design.output: Detailed proposed 00/01 and task cards, source-to-question-to-method links and unresolved choices; approval/freezing stays with the outer operator.

execution.output: Executable phase contracts and tested implementation for authorized task nodes; runtime alone launches durable jobs.

recovery.output: An evidence-backed repair proposal with a real minimal test and preserved successful artifacts; no budget reset or scientific scope change.

interpretation.output: Run-bound reflection with actual literature search, expected/observed comparison, alternatives and downstream impact.

reporting.output: Same-source README/Word, tables, figures, detailed methods/results/conclusions and complete run-bound QC evidence.

visualization.output: Publication-ready, lineage-traceable result figures with reproducible source, vector/raster exports and bounded visual QC corrections.

review.output: An evidence-linked adequate/revise/needs_user review; distinguish structural checks from scientific assessment.
